Atlas of Anti-Black Violence, 1903

The episodes of anti-Black violence in 1903 from our dossiers, one for every eligible event in the year table, placed on 1910 county lines and month by month through the year. Hover a mark for the event table's short summary; click or tap it to read the dossier's account. Drafts: no entry has had human review.

Each dot is an episode, in the month it happened, grouped by type; the number is the month’s total.
